Welcome to Light Switch

Be part of the Light Switch Community

Join us on Discord.

Documentation

Feeling a little lost? Head over to our documentation page for some direction, or jump on Discord and ask a question.
LIGHT_SWITCH.SettingHint: When enabled and not on the Lighting layer, GMs can see ambient light icons and left-click them to toggle hidden on/off.
LIGHT_SWITCH.PlayerControlTagSettingHint: Optional Tagger tag name. If set, players only see and control ambient lights with this tag. Leave empty to allow all scene lights.
LIGHT_SWITCH.PlayerInteractionDistanceSe: Maximum distance in grid units that a player can interact with a light. Set to 0 to disable distance limits.
LIGHT_SWITCH.PlayerDistanceVisibilitySet: Limit Player Light Visibility By Distance
If enabled and interaction distance is greater than 0, players only see light switch icons within that distance.
LIGHT_SWITCH.PlayerHideIconsSettingHint: When enabled, player light switch icons remain clickable but render at opacity 0 for immersive play.
LIGHT_SWITCH.HideByLevelSettingHint: Hide Light Switch icons if the ambient light is not in the currently viewed level/elevation.
LIGHT_SWITCH.ShowByLevelsV13SettingHint: If Levels UI range is enabled, only show light icons with elevation inside the current Levels UI range.
LIGHT_SWITCH.KeybindingToggleHint: Toggle the Light Switch tool on/off. Default: Shift+L.
LIGHT_SWITCH.KeybindingTagPanelHint: Open or close the Scene Light Panel. Default: Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+L.
LIGHT_SWITCH.LightGraphicEnableHint: Display a custom image or video centered on this light for all users while the light is on.
LIGHT_SWITCH.LightGraphicPathHint: Choose an image or video. On The Forge this picker prefers the Assets Library source.
LIGHT_SWITCH.LightGraphicScaleHint: Scale the graphic from 0.1 to 5.0 in 0.05 steps using the slider or number input. This does not replace the Light Switch icon, and the preview updates live while this configuration window is open.
LIGHT_SWITCH.LightGraphicRotationHint: Rotate the graphic from 0 to 360 degrees using the slider.
